title_zh: 查明申请页面为何仍显示待补材料

scenario.label_zh: 询问课程申请材料状态
scenario.goal_zh: 核对申请材料是否收到，澄清页面更新延迟与录取决定的区别

context_zh: 泰莎已上传课程申请附件，但界面仍显示缺少材料，她向课程行政人员马利克查询。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Applicant Tessa
sentences.text: I am an applicant for the evening design course. Apparently my portfolio is missing, but I uploaded it yesterday.

sentences.speaker: Administrator Malik
sentences.text: Let me check your record. What is your application number?

sentences.speaker: Applicant Tessa
sentences.text: D forty-two. I also have an email confirming the upload.

sentences.speaker: Administrator Malik
sentences.text: I can see the file now. The status page has not updated yet; your materials are complete.

sentences.speaker: Applicant Tessa
sentences.text: Does that mean I have a place on the course?

sentences.speaker: Administrator Malik
sentences.text: Not yet. The tutors still have to review the applications. You do not need to upload the file again.

sentences.speaker: Applicant Tessa
sentences.text: Thanks for checking. I will keep the receipt and wait for the review email.

targets.sense_zh: 根据所见或所得信息似乎如此
